desc: Implement DP with sets using two dictionaries (empty and non-empty) tracking sets of products.
Optimize DP: discard products > limit immediately during transitions.
Test with the three examples: [1,2,3] k=2 limit=10, [0,2,3] k=-5 limit=12, [2,2,3,3] k=0 limit=9.
Add heuristic pruning: if a product set exceeds 100 elements, keep only the largest 50 products to control memory/time.
Handle edge cases: n=0, all zeros, k out of bounds, single element, limit=0.
Final review: ensure rolling dictionary updates, verify complexity for n=150 and limit=5000.
